front.intro: Behind this East End bungalow, a long covered patio runs beside a large covered garage in a fenced yard. The driveway is new, and so is the fence. Inside, the wiring, plumbing and roof are all new, along with the kitchen and both baths. The foundation was reworked, leveled and braced before any of it went in. The Breakfast Nook opens to the rear deck. A new walk leads to the covered front stoop. A Craftsman-style front door opens off the covered porch.

photoA.name: Covered Patio
photoA.text: A long covered patio runs along the back of the house, open to the yard on one side. Deck steps lead down from the Breakfast Nook's rear door. There is room for a grill, a long table and a seating group. The yard around it is fenced.

photoB.name: Covered Garage
photoB.text: Wood posts and a concrete floor sit under a solid roof. It is wide and deep enough to park under or to work in. The patio runs right beside it. The covered garage sits at the very back of the lot, behind the fenced yard.

back.planNote: The street and the front porch are at left. The deck, the covered patio and the covered garage sit at right, in the fenced yard. The Primary Bedroom is at the back of the house, with the Primary Bath beside it. The Dining area sits between the Kitchen and the hall to the bedrooms. Approximate and not to scale; the buyer verifies every room size.

claim.small: An East End bungalow with three-phase power. The roof and the siding are new. The yard is fenced. The kitchen and both baths are all new. The front gable has board and batten siding.
claim.head: What is new

floors.text: The front door opens into the Living Room, and a wide cased opening joins it to the Dining area and the Kitchen. The Breakfast Nook sits beside the Kitchen, with a door to the rear deck. The Primary Bedroom is at the back, with a vaulted ceiling and its own bath. Two more bedrooms share the hall bath. The covered patio and the garage sit out back, past the deck steps.
The family room has a high tray ceiling and a bank of large windows. The dining area sits beside it. The primary bath has a deep soaking tub and a separate shower.

back.footnote: Information deemed reliable but not guaranteed. Room sizes are approximate. Living area of 1,385 square feet per HCAD.

top.title: From the Front Door to the Kitchen
top.head: The front rooms
top.sub: One line of sight, door to kitchen
top.lede: Come through the front door and you are standing in the Living Room. A wide cased opening joins it to the Dining area, and the Kitchen peninsula is a few steps beyond. The hall to the bedrooms starts at the Dining area, so the bedrooms stay out of the way of the front rooms. Everything on this side of the house is new, from the floors to the lighting.
top.quote: Wood-look floors run through with no thresholds.
top.close: The Kitchen is an L with a peninsula, and the peninsula doubles as the breakfast bar. Two pendant lights hang over it, with room for barstools. The Dining area sits between the peninsula and the hall. The pantry and the Breakfast Nook are around the corner from the range. The sink and dishwasher sit a step apart along the L. A round table fits in the middle of the Nook, with room to walk around it. Counters run the full length of the L. Marble-look tile rises behind the range.

items.name: Living Room
items.text: The front door opens straight into this room from the stoop. A clerestory window high on the wall adds daylight and keeps privacy. A wide cased opening joins it to the Dining area and the Kitchen. New floors, trim and lighting carry through.

items.name: Kitchen
items.text: All new, in an L with navy lower cabinets and white shaker uppers. A stainless range sits under a chimney hood. The sink and dishwasher are beside it. The pantry is a step away.

items.name: Dining Area
items.text: From the Dining area, the front door and Living Room are on one side and the Kitchen peninsula is on the other. The hall to the bedrooms starts here. Wood-look floors run through without a threshold. A sputnik-style light hangs over the table.

items.name: Breakfast Nook
items.text: Windows fill two walls of the nook, beside the Kitchen. A round table fits in the middle, with room to walk around it. The marble-look backsplash wraps around the corner.

items.name: Breakfast Bar
items.text: Two pendant lights hang over the peninsula, with room for barstools. The Dining area sits between the peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms. Marble-look counters run its full length.

items.name: Range and Sink
items.text: Everything on this wall is new, with a stainless range under a chimney hood. The sink and dishwasher sit a step apart. White shaker uppers reach up to the ceiling. Navy cabinets run underneath. The pantry and the Nook are around the corner.

bottom.kicker: The back half of the house
bottom.title: Bedrooms, Baths and Built-Ins
bottom.head: The bedroom wing
bottom.lede: The Primary Bedroom sits at the back of the house, well away from the street and the front rooms. Bedrooms 2 and 3 open off the hall near the front, and they share the hall bath. Every bedroom has a closet, and the Primary has a shelving tower with rods on both sides. The bath and the walk-in shower are all new. New carpet runs wall to wall in the bedrooms.
bottom.quote: A bedroom wing that stays quiet.
bottom.close: The hall bath is a few steps from both secondary bedrooms. The larger of the two sits at the front corner, with windows on two walls. The other has a hall-side closet that leaves the window wall open for a desk. Tile climbs the walls in every bath. The Primary Bath has a niche for shampoo and soap, a rain showerhead and a handheld. The vanity is navy, with drawers and a marble-look top. Interior laundry sits on the same floor. Each bath is all new, from the tile to the lighting.

items.name: Primary Bedroom
items.text: Set at the back of the home, away from the street. The vaulted ceiling carries an exposed painted beam. Windows on two walls bring in daylight. It fits a king bed and a long dresser.

items.name: Primary Bath
items.text: Double sinks sit on a navy vanity with drawers. A wide LED mirror lights the wall above. Two people can get ready at once. The walk-in shower is just beyond, behind a glass door.

items.name: Hall Bath
items.text: Bedrooms 2 and 3 share this bath, a few steps down the hall. A tub sits under full-height marble-look tile. A pebble tile niche holds soap and shampoo. Everything in the room is new.

items.name: Primary Closet
items.text: Double doors open to a shelving tower with hanging rods on both sides. A shelf runs along the back wall. The built-ins stay with the house. The closet opens off the Primary Bedroom.

items.name: Bedroom 2
items.text: The larger secondary bedroom sits at the front corner of the house. Windows on two walls bring in daylight. It shares the hall bath with Bedroom 3. The closet has double doors.

items.name: Bedroom 3
items.text: The closet sits on the hall side, which leaves the window wall open for a desk. The hall bath is a few steps away. New carpet runs underfoot. It sits between Bedroom 2 and the Primary.

a.sub: A covered garage and a covered patio out back
a.text: Come in under the board and batten gable and walk straight back through the Living Room, the Dining area and the L-shaped Kitchen. The Primary sits at the back under a vaulted ceiling. Past the deck steps, the covered garage and the covered patio share the fenced yard, with string lights overhead.
